fusions.name: Downstroke
fusions.desc: A chop that deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds, leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hew the Swollen
fusions.desc: A swing through a cone 2.5 tiles long that deals 7 damage to everything in it. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction the target carries (max 40%). It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Hollow Trunk Felled
fusions.desc: Fells a trunk 5 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Spiked Poll
fusions.desc: Conjures an axe: your weapon damage rises by 12%, you attack 5% faster, and every strike with it leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
